definition.text: (in the LXX. called “Thorgal”), styled the “king of nations” (Gen. 14:1-9). Mentioned as Tudkhula on Arioch’s brick (see facing page 139). Goyyim, translated “nations,” is the country called Gutium, east of Tigris and north of Elam.

works.title: Ante-Nicene Fathers, Volume 2: Fathers of the Second Century

chapters.title: The Destruction Of The Sodomites By The Assyrian War.
